name: Enterprise Person and Contextual Identity
constraints: WM-PER-001 remains the person-anchor master across HRIS, ATS, directory and LMS records.
Display name and email are never identity keys.
Deterministic linking requires a non-reassigned scheme-qualified identifier in the same authority and applicability domain.
Other matches remain proposed links with confidence, rule-set version, state and authorizing role.
Merge preserves resolvable tombstones and supports reversal.
Names are effective-dated assertions and name change never changes the person anchor.
Pseudonyms are typed and purpose-bound and cannot seed cross-domain merging.
Contact verification proves channel control and never person identity.
Every disclosure declares purpose and released attributes.
Employment facts remain owned by employment relationships rather than the person aggregate.
